ammonia.reason: limited amino acid deamination during 12-mo ripening, far below washed-rind levels

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol/indole from Tyr/Trp catabolism by raw-milk microbiota plus pasture feed

bitter.reason: hydrophobic peptides largely hydrolysed by Lb. helveticus peptidases, well balanced

blue_moldy.reason: no Penicillium; low heptan-2-one ~5 mg/kg from fatty acid beta-oxidation only

browning.reason: Maillard between free amino acids from proteolysis and residual galactose on heating

buttery.reason: diacetyl ~3 mg/kg from citrate metabolism by Streptococcus thermophilus/Lactococcus

cheesy_sweaty.reason: butyric acid ~400 mg/kg from milk-fat lipolysis by microbial esterases

creaminess.reason: high fat ~35% gives mouth-coating but firm low-moisture matrix limits creaminess

crumbliness.reason: moderate proteolysis plus tyrosine crystals cause shortness without grana friability

firmness.reason: cooked-pressed low-moisture ~34% calcium-phosphate crosslinked network hardened over 12 mo

floral_honey.reason: phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine catabolism by lactobacilli

fruity.reason: ethyl hexanoate ~5 mg/kg from ethanol plus hexanoic acid esterification by lactic flora

goaty.reason: cow milk lacks goaty branched C8-C10 acids; only trace hexanoic/octanoic acid

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker aldehydes 2-methylpropanal/2- and 3-methylbutanal from Val/Leu/Ile via Lb. helveticus

melt.reason: pH ~5.8 with intact para-casein and moderate salt allows flow and fusion on heating

mushroom_earthy.reason: trace 1-octen-3-ol from linoleic acid oxidation, mainly rind-associated

oil_off.reason: free-fat coalescence on melting from large fat pools in aged cooked curd

smoky.reason: never smoked; no guaiacol/syringol from smoke

sour_vinegar.reason: low acetic acid at pH ~5.85; propionic ~1000 mg/kg present as milder propionate

stretch.reason: rennet-coagulated non-pasta-filata; no aligned micelle fibers so minimal extensibility

sulfur_cooked.reason: cooked curd ~53-55C plus Met catabolism to methional/sulfides by lactobacilli, mild

sweet.reason: lactose depleted but sweet from Pro/Ala/Gly, calcium lactate, low salt and low acidity

umami.reason: high free glutamate from extensive rennet plus Lb. helveticus proteolysis/peptidolysis
